Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

today is thursday . i came home from a trip 3 days before the day after last monday . how many days have i been home ?

A. 1 day
B. 2 days
C. 7 days
D. 6 days
E. 10 days

message.content:
Came home 3 days before the day after last Monday = Saturday. Counting through today (Thursday) gives 6 days.

ANSWER: D
message.reasoning_content: Came home: day after last Monday = Tuesday; 3 days before = Saturday. From Saturday to Thursday = 5 days... not an option. Hmm. Maybe "last Monday" — today Thursday, last Monday is 3 days ago. Day after = 2 days ago; 3 days before = 5 days ago... same, 5. Options include 6? If counting today as home day: Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday = 6 days. Answer D.
